TOKEN-DEFERRED-BURN-LP-RESERVE-DESYNC.reason: Victims are individually deployed BSC/Base tokens with custom transfer logic that are not listed as DefiLlama protocols; the family has no addressable protocol population in this universe. Handed to the token-level monitoring workstream instead.

TOKEN-TRANSFER-OVERRIDE-BREAKS-CONSERVAT.reason: Same population problem as the deferred-burn family.

TOKEN-TRANSFER-INTENT-HEURISTIC-FORGEABL.reason: Same population problem as the deferred-burn family.

HOOK-ZERO-VALUE-TRANSFER-TRIGGERS-ACCRUA.reason: Applies to token contracts with accrual hooks; only reachable through per-token screening, not the protocol universe.

TOKEN-PACKED-OWNERSHIP-UNDERFLOW.reason: Requires DN404/BT404 lineage; no in-universe protocol above the TVL threshold carries it.

AUTH-ZERO-ADDRESS-ACCEPTED.reason: Screened as a cheap read-only sweep (owner()==address(0) with non-zero balance) rather than as a protocol-family pair.

SECRET-EMBEDDED-IN-PUBLIC-CODE-AS-AUTH.reason: Requires bytecode constant analysis per contract; run as a sweep over deep-screened deployments rather than as a ranked pair.

STORAGE-LAYOUT-COLLISION-PHANTOM-CREDIT.reason: Requires a storage-layout dump per contract; run as a sweep over deep-screened deployments.

METATX-SENDER-IDENTITY-CONFUSION.reason: Requires ERC-2771 detection per contract; run as a sweep.

ACC-CREDIT-NOT-RECEIVED.reason: Reward-tracker contracts are rarely separate DefiLlama entries; folded into the reward-index sweep.

ACC-DUPLICATE-ID-ACCUMULATION.reason: Detected by selector-shape sweep over deep-screened deployments.

ACC-SIGN-OR-BOUND-CHECK-MISSING.reason: Detected by parameter-shape sweep over deep-screened deployments.

ACC-HARDCODED-PEG-REDEMPTION.reason: Folded into the stablecoin-issuer oracle screen.

SIG-VERIFIER-DEFEATABLE.reason: Detected by source-grep sweep over deep-screened deployments.

AUTH-IDENTITY-SATISFIABLE-BY-ATTACKER-CO.reason: Detected by source-grep sweep over deep-screened deployments.

AUTH-PUBLIC-CLAIM-NO-ELIGIBILITY.reason: Detected by selector sweep over deep-screened deployments.
